messages:
Ava: Quick proposal  run a 24-seat Design Partner pilot that recruits by primary use-case (composer, reranker, and data-enrichment). goal: triangulate real asks per use-case and validate distinct onboarding flows + gating metrics.
Mina: Love it. Instead of psychographic tags, we ask folks to pick their primary "what I'm trying to build" (one of the three). keep screener <40s. target 8 per use-case.
Theo: For outreach, test two incentive bundles: (A) extended onboarding + 2h office hours, (B) $300 credit + async priority. track which improves completed feedback sessions.
Riya: Onboarding will diverge: composer gets prompt templates & eval harness, reranker gets labeled-example ingestion guide, enrichment gets connector checklist. We should prepare three one-pagers.
Omar: Security ask: if customers upload small labeled datasets for reranking, we need sandboxed storage + retention rules. propose a 30-day auto-delete by default with opt-in for longer retention.
Ben: Ops capacity: 24 total is fine if we run in three waves of 8 over 3 weeks. limit 1:1 hours per participant to 3 during onboarding window.
Priya: Legal: add a single checkbox consent covering telemetry + sample data handling. I'll draft a one-line clause and a short link to pilot terms. avoid creating heavy contract burden.
Mina: Success criteria per use-case (draft):
- Composer: 70% produce a working prompt bundle + 2 eval runs within 14 days.
- Reranker: ingest path tested and 50% show measurable reranking lift on a small test set.
- Enrichment: 60% integrate connector and report a data-complete metric improvement.
Ava: Measurement plan: funnel events (invite_sent, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts), feedback_sessions_count, sample_artifact_uploaded_ts, quality_delta_metric. we'll collect 30d NPS.
Theo: Recruitment copy test: "Ship the feature: composer" vs "Improve relevance: reranking" vs "Streamline data: enrichment". A/B subject lines on small invite batches.
Riya: Onboard checklist (condensed):
1) pick use-case and get tailored one-pager
2) issue API key + run canonical sample call
3) upload one sample artifact (prompt set/labeled examples/connector mapping)
4) schedule 1:1 + join cohort slack
Can we auto-validate #3 and flag common errors?
Ben: I'll add a small ingestion validator script for #3 that returns pass/fail and a short error hint. will commit as a gist.
Omar: Also include a minimal data handling note in the uploader: "do not upload PHI" and detect obvious patterns (emails/SSNs) and warn.
Priya: Consent line ready: "I consent to anonymized usage telemetry and temporary storage of sample data for the pilot per the linked pilot terms." will post link.
dp-bot: Reminder: register cohort in dp-beta-queue and tag participants with chosen use-case after screener pass. :robot_face:
Mina: For analytics, sample CSV fields: participant_id, use_case, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts, artifact_uploaded_ts, feedback_sessions_count, quality_delta_pct, nps_30. I'll paste a tiny example in the spec doc.
Ava: Launch gates (must meet all to roll to next stage):
- >=20 participants onboarded and artifact uploaded
- At least one clear feature ask per use-case with >30% cohort support
- No unresolved security/data handling blockers
- Ops capacity confirmed for GA ramp
Theo: Timeline: open screener next Monday, run waves weeks 1-3, collect immediate feedback during weeks 2-6, final review week 7.
Ben: I will reserve ops windows and schedule 1:1 slots per wave in calendar.
Priya: I'll post the pilot blurb and checkbox copy in the invites doc by EOD. Omar I'll loop in on data retention specifics.
Mina: I'll draft the screener and the one-pagers and share a short spec doc. keep everything light and actionable.
Ava: Great. If no objections I'll greenlight outreach next Monday and lock wave 1. thumbs up?
Riya: thumbs up.
Theo: :thumbsup:
Omar: ok from security side pending the 30-day default retention.
Priya: good from legal with the pilot clause.
Ben: go ahead.
dp-bot: Action: create dp-beta-queue entry with tag "usecase-triangulation" when screener published.
